conclusion: Larger context is essentially FREE on the 3060 for Bonsai-2: decode stays ~71 t/s from 32K to 64K ctx (hybrid GDN attention keeps KV tiny). q4_0 KV saves ~1.1GB at 64K (9956 vs 11044 MiB) with no decode cost. MTP (draft-mtp n_max 2) is the single biggest decode lever: 45 -> 71 t/s (+58%). ubatch 2048 helps prefill only at >4K ctx (589.9 vs 580.5 pp4096); ub512 fine below. Best config: PTQ1_0 + MTP + q4_0 KV + ub2048 for long prompts.
best_config: PTQ1_0.gguf, --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 2, -ctk/v q4_0, -fa 1, -ub 2048 (long prompts) / 512 (short), -c up to 64K+
